paper_statement: For bias-free width-200 ReLU MLPs through layer 30, the ensemble-mean NTK scales linearly with depth at critical C_W=2 and is exponentially unstable away from criticality; Figure 1 uses 1000 initializations.
quantifier: For the two fixed Appendix D inputs, layers 1 through 30, width 200, and 1000 iid Gaussian network initializations at each of C_W in {0.25, 2, 4}.
assumptions: output-channel trace average permitted by Appendix C
pass_condition: At C_W=2 the diagonal slope agrees with ||x_0||^2/2 within 3 SE, max relative deviation is <=10%, at least 27/30 points lie within pointwise 99% intervals, diagonal R^2>=0.995 and depths 10-30 off-diagonal R^2>=0.98; C_W=4 has log-slope >=0.20, C_W=0.25 has log-slope <=-0.20, and the high curve is rejected by the critical contract; an independent tiny-network checker validates the estimator.
